question: Which body is responsible for resolving disputes related to the election of the President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Supreme Court**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Disputes related to the election of the President of India are resolved exclusively by the **Supreme Court of India**.
 
• The authority of the Supreme Court in such matters is derived from **Article 71 of the Indian Constitution**.
 
• In its adjudication, the Supreme Court has the power to declare an election void if it finds any malpractice or irregularities.
 
• The decision of the Supreme Court in these disputes is **final and binding**.
 
• The Election Commission conducts the election, but disputes arising from it fall under the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 71 of the Indian Constitution:**

 
 
• It outlines the responsibility of the Supreme Court in handling disputes related to the election of the President and Vice-President of India.
 
• The Supreme Court’s decision is considered final under this article.
 
 
 
• **Election Process:**
 
 
• The President of India is elected by an electoral college consisting of elected members of both Houses of Parliament and the Legislative Assemblies of States and Union Territories.
 
• The process is conducted by the Election Commission of India as per the provisions of the Presidential and Vice-Presidential Elections Act, 1952.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Election Commission:**
 
 
• The Election Commission of India oversees the conduct of Presidential elections.
 
• However, it does not have the authority to resolve disputes arising from these elections.
 
 
 
• **Jurisdiction of the Supreme Court:**
 
 
• The Supreme Court has original jurisdiction in disputes related to the election of the President and Vice-President of India.
 
• This jurisdiction ensures the impartiality and fairness of the electoral process.
